checks.name: Solver finished without errors
checks.meaning: A crash or floating-point exception usually means the solution blew up or a setting is invalid.

checks.name: No NaN values
checks.meaning: NaN (not a number) means the calculation produced invalid values.

checks.name: Max Courant number
checks.meaning: Fluid should not cross more than about one cell per time step (limit used: 1.0).

checks.name: Courant number trend
checks.meaning: A steadily growing Courant number is the typical signature of a blow-up.

checks.name: Residual trend: Ux
checks.meaning: Residuals should fall or level off. Growth suggests divergence (or a near-zero field whose normalised residual is only noise).

checks.name: Residual trend: Uy
checks.meaning: Residuals should fall or level off. Growth suggests divergence (or a near-zero field whose normalised residual is only noise).

checks.name: Residual trend: p
checks.meaning: Residuals should fall or level off. Growth suggests divergence (or a near-zero field whose normalised residual is only noise).

checks.name: Continuity-error trend
checks.meaning: Mass-conservation error per step; strong growth means the solution is degrading.
